title: 第12章 帮皇上搞钱
slug: 快活小御医恭喜皇后有喜了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“林爱卿……”

刘烈刚要开口封赏，脸上的狂喜之色，却迅速褪去，转而被一股浓浓的愁容所取代。

他颓然地坐回龙椅，长长叹了口气。

“唉……”

林墨眉头微挑：“陛下，大获全胜，为何反而唉声叹气？”

刘烈指着桌上那份策论，无奈道：“策是好策，可惜……朕手里没钱啊！”

“国库的钥匙，还攥在那老妖婆手里。”

“她今天吃了这么大一个亏，怎么可能拨给朕一文钱？”

“朕刚刚派人去户部催问，结果户部尚书说，如今国库空虚，连京城禁军的军饷都快发不出了，一个铜板都拿不出来！”

刘烈越说越气，一拳砸在龙案上。

“朕也想过，让京城那些勋贵皇商捐款，可他们一个个都跟朕哭穷！”

“他们怕太后，不敢给朕投钱！”

“林爱卿，你说这可怎么办？”

“这以工代赈，最关键的就是要先给灾民发钱发粮，让他们看到希望。”

“若是半个月内，这第一笔启动的钱粮还不到位，几十万灾民一旦绝望，就会立刻啸聚山林，变成流寇！”

“到那时，这以工代赈，就成了天大的笑话！”

“太后依然能以此为由，直接废了朕！”

说完，他神色绝望地闭上双眼。

王喜等人听了，通通傻眼。

他们本以为已经走出了绝境，却没想，前面还有一个更大的坑在等着。

谁知，林墨听完，非但没有愁容，反而淡然一笑。

“陛下，国库没钱，商贾不捐，其实都不是问题。”

刘烈精神一振：“哦？爱卿又有妙计？”

“妙计谈不上，只是一个让天下商贾，哭着喊着，争着抢着，把钱送到我们手里的法子罢了。”

林墨走到刘烈面前，压低了声音。

“陛下，咱们可以搞一个——大乾皇家特许经营权拍卖会！”

“再辅以一种名为——赈灾福利奖券的东西，来个双管齐下！”

“特许经营权？福利奖券？”

刘烈听得一头雾水，这些词他连听都没听过。

王喜等人，同样面面相觑。

林墨耐心解释道，“简单说，就是把一些以前只有朝廷能做的生意，拿出来公开拍卖！”

“比如，这江南水利修好后，沿岸肯定会多出大片良田。”

Page (1/3)

"Lin Aiqing..."

Just as Liu Lie was about to open his mouth to award the reward, the ecstasy on his face quickly faded and was replaced by a deep sadness.

He sat back on the dragon chair slumpedly and let out a long sigh.

"Alas..."

Lin Mo raised his eyebrows slightly: "Your Majesty, you have won a great victory, why are you sighing instead?"

Liu Lie pointed to the strategy on the table and said helplessly: "The strategy is a good one, but it's a pity... I don't have any money!"

"The key to the treasury is still in the hands of that old witch."

"She suffered such a big loss today, how could she allocate a penny to me?"

"I just sent someone to the Ministry of Household Affairs to press for questioning, but the Minister of the Ministry of Household Affairs said that the treasury is now empty, and even the military salaries of the imperial guards in the capital can hardly be paid out, and not a single copper coin can be produced!"

The more Liu Lie talked, the angrier he became and punched Long An.

"I also thought about asking the noble merchants in the capital to donate money, but they all cried out to me about poverty!"

"They are afraid of the Queen Mother and don't dare to invest money in me!"

"Lin Aiqing, what do you think we should do?"

“The most important thing about this work-for-relief program is to first give money and food to the victims, so that they can see hope.”

"If within half a month, the first initial amount of money and food is not received, hundreds of thousands of victims will immediately gather in the mountains and forests and become rogue bandits once they become desperate!"

“By then, this work-for-relief scheme will become a big joke!”

"The Queen Mother can still use this as an excuse to directly destroy me!"

After saying that, he closed his eyes with a look of despair.

Wang Xi and others were dumbfounded after hearing this.

They thought they had gotten out of the desperate situation, but they didn't expect that there was a bigger pit waiting ahead.

Unexpectedly, after listening to this, Lin Mo not only did not look sad, but smiled calmly.

"Your Majesty, the treasury has no money and the merchants don't donate. In fact, it is not a problem."

Liu Lie perked up: "Oh? Aiqing has another clever plan?"

"It's not a clever plan, it's just a way to make the merchants from all over the world cry, shout, and scramble to get the money into our hands."

Lin Mo walked up to Liu Lie and lowered his voice.

"Your Majesty, we can hold an auction for the royal franchise of Daqian!"

"Added by something called disaster relief welfare coupons, it's a two-pronged approach!"

"Franchise? Welfare coupons?"

Liu Lie was confused. He had never heard these words before.

Wang Xi and others also looked at each other in confusion.

Lin Mo explained patiently, "To put it simply, it is to put some businesses that only the imperial court could do in the past to a public auction!"

"For example, after the water conservancy in the south of the Yangtze River is repaired, there will definitely be a lot of fertile farmland along the coast."
